name: Generating Mischief
description: A classic little glass light bulb that occasionally flickers on. Its power source is unknown, though rumor has it that it runs on the inspiration inside the wearer's head.
story:
"Passenger, why is the light bulb on your head glowing? I'm warning you, do not wreck the Express."
"Aaaah, don't come closer with that creepy smile!"

source.description: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
